title: Stressed Pronouns - {moi, toi, lui...}
description: Learn the special pronouns used after words like 'with', 'for', 'without' - different from subject pronouns!
can_do: Use special pronouns after 'with', 'for', 'without' (avec moi, pour toi)
Emphasize who you're talking about (c'est moi - it's me)

concepts.definition: Special pronouns used after prepositions, for emphasis, and alone
concepts.example: Can't use '{je}' or '{tu}' after '{avec}' or '{pour}' - need '{moi}' and '{toi}'!

concepts.definition: After prepositions (avec, pour, sans, chez), for emphasis, or alone
concepts.example: {avec moi} (with me), {pour toi} (for you), {c'est lui} (it's him), {Moi?} ({Me?})

concepts.definition: Subject pronouns go before verbs. Stressed pronouns go after prepositions.
concepts.example: {je suis} (I am) BUT avec moi (with me) - different pronouns!
